title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Service Agent in Microsoft 365 as a dedicated service specialist
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and the documented Public Preview billing and prerequisites. Its general blocking controls are documented, and it explicitly avoids claiming that Microsoft has confirmed their applicability to this Service Agent.

claims.claim: The general organization-wide Block action is under Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > select an agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > All agents.
In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.
